messages:
Maya CSM: Kicking off HelixPay onboarding thread. Goal: production pilot -> GA within 30-60 days. Need to confirm owners, success criteria, and early enablement schedule. Who owns infra, integration, and enablement?
Samir Solutions: I can own enablement and the customer playbook. Suggest a 30min workshop in week 1 covering API flows, auth, and common errors.
Anjali PM: Ill take product acceptance criteria. Propose these metrics: 95% request completeness, p50 latency <300ms, and two core user tasks completed in an initial session.
Diego Eng: Engineering checklist: SSO (SAML) configured, sample PII-mapped dataset, network allowlist. @Maya please share dataset samples and which model variants well benchmark.
Maya CSM: Uploading assets to shared bucket and linking the ops doc now. Calendar invite will follow. Link: https://redwood.team/ops/helixpay-onboard (internal).
Ruth Security: Ill run the security/compliance checklist. Note: customer requires SOC2 + custom DPA residency clause  expect ~5 business days for legal review.
Jordan Success-ops: Ill manage the enablement checklist and record the session. Proposed workshop checklist:
- Intro & stakeholders
- API keys & scopes
- SSO smoke test
- Sample req/res walkthrough
- Error modes & retry guidance
- Post-workshop feedback form link
Samir Solutions: Love it. Can we add a short 10min lab to instrument a call and check token-level cost breakdown?
Anjali PM: Add acceptance test cases: happy path, rate-limit recovery, truncated response handling.
Diego Eng: For perf benching well need the load script and model/quant variants. Example command:
python perf/run_client.py --host helixpay-api.redwood --threads 8 --seq 1024 --model redwood-v1-quant
Maya CSM: Owners recap: Enablement = Samir, Product acceptance = Anjali, Eng integration = Diego, Security = Ruth, Success-ops = Jordan. Ill own program status updates.
Ruth Security: Share any external DPA drafts with legal@redwood and cc me. Ill prioritize once we have a draft.
Jordan Success-ops: Ill publish a 5-question feedback form + NPS after the workshop. Will share template by EOD.
Samir Solutions: Weekly sync Fridays 10am PT? Open to rotating for other time zones.
Anjali PM: Friday 10am PT works for product stakeholders.
Diego Eng: Eng fine with weekly but prefer biweekly deep-dive aligned with sprint cadence.
Maya CSM: Agreement: weekly 30m check-ins (Fri 10am PT) + biweekly eng deep-dive. Ill send invites and create onboarding tracker.
oncall-bot: Reminder - create meeting invite with conference link zoom.redwood/helixpay and enable recording.
Maya CSM: Action items:
1) Samir: workshop deck + 10m lab (due in 3 business days)
2) Diego: perf bench scripts + network allowlist checklist (due in 4 business days)
3) Ruth: compliance review kickoff (due in 5 business days)
4) Jordan: feedback form + recording template (due EOD)
5) Anjali: acceptance test cases (due in 3 business days)
Ill follow up in #status-thread after the workshop.
Samir Solutions: Ill draft the deck and request a dry run slot.
Diego Eng: Will drop sample dataset link here after I get bucket access.
Maya CSM: Thanks everyone closing initial thread. Ill post the meeting invite in 15m and create the Workfront tracker card.
Jordan Success-ops: Thanks, will draft the post-workshop survey.
Anjali PM: 👍
Samir Solutions: 👍
Ruth Security: 👍
